# Kota

> Desktop app that runs agent CLIs in project-scoped rooms and presents their history in one shared view. macOS, Apple Silicon.

- Product: https://www.kota.place/
- Download: https://github.com/stabruriss/kota-app/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/stabruriss/kota-app
- Docs: https://www.kota.place/docs/
- Whitepaper: https://www.kota.place/docs/research/long-term-teammates/v1/
- CLI host compatibility: https://www.kota.place/docs/cli-host-compatibility/
